question: Chitra Visweswaran is a famous dancer of which of the following dance genres?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chitra Visweswaran** is a renowned dancer known for her contributions to the classical dance form of **Bharatnatyam**.
 
• Bharatnatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from the temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, expressive hand gestures, and elaborate costumes.
 
• Chitra Visweswaran has received numerous awards and accolades for her performances and has significantly contributed to the propagation and teaching of Bharatnatyam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bharatnatyam is traditionally performed by women and is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive gestures and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form is accompanied by classical Carnatic music and is deeply rooted in the Bhakti movement, emphasizing devotion and spirituality.
 
• Chitra Visweswaran has trained under several eminent gurus and has established her own dance academy to train future generations in Bharatnatyam.
